context_requirements: Expression of MME (neprilysin) on the cell surface
Presence of MME substrate peptides whose cleavage products would otherwise modulate transcription
An intact downstream signaling pathway responsive to the relevant peptide substrate
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression after 6 or 24 h treatment with a membrane metalloendopeptidase inhibitor in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple MME inhibitors that is absent in MME-negative lines
Rescue of the transcriptional response by MME overexpression or exogenous substrate
